strings.text: Both due on the same date. The screening is the WPPSI-IV, booked and paid for directly with a CAIS-designated psychologist ($300, separate from the school's $100 fee) — appointments open the day after Labor Day. The classroom visit is your child's, on campus.

strings.text: Why JK/K is its own band
strings.t: Poukisa JK/K se yon nivo apa

strings.text: This band runs on an **entirely earlier calendar** — application Jan 2 rather than Jan 15, decisions Feb 26 rather than April 9. It also carries two requirements the older bands do not: a **separately deadlined teacher recommendation** and a **classroom visit** for your child. Miss the Jan 2 date and you are not on the Grades 1–12 track as a fallback; you are late for this one.
strings.t: Nivo sa a mache sou yon **kalandriye ki pi bonè nèt** — aplikasyon 2 janvye olye 15 janvye, desizyon 26 fevriye olye 9 avril. Li mande tou de bagay lòt nivo yo pa mande: yon **rekòmandasyon pwofesè ki gen pwòp dat limit pa l** ak yon **vizit nan klas** pou pitit ou. Si w rate dat 2 janvye a, ou pa tonbe sou chemen nivo 1–12 la kòm rezèv; ou annreta pou sa a.
Yon sèl tès sèvi pou sèt lekòl

strings.text: The CAIS screening is a consortium assessment: "your child will be evaluated only one time by a licensed psychologist designated by CAIS," and that single evaluation is accepted by **all seven member schools** — so applying to several Charlotte independents does not mean testing several times. Two rules bind, though: you must **apply to a school before it will consider your evaluation**, testing may happen **only once in a twelve-month period**, and any sign of coaching, tutoring or re-testing "will invalidate your application to any CAIS school."
strings.t: Evalyasyon CAIS la se yon evalyasyon konsòsyòm: "yo pral evalye pitit ou yon sèl fwa pa yon sikològ ki gen lisans epi CAIS deziyen," epi **tout sèt lekòl manm yo** aksepte sèl evalyasyon sa a — donk aplike nan plizyè lekòl endepandan Charlotte pa vle di pase plizyè tès. Men gen de règ ki aplike: fòk ou **aplike nan yon lekòl anvan li konsidere evalyasyon w la**, tès la ka fèt **yon sèl fwa nan douz mwa**, epi nenpòt siy antrènman, leson patikilye oswa repase tès la "ap anile aplikasyon w nan nenpòt lekòl CAIS."

strings.text: Your deadline is Jan 2, not Jan 15.
strings.t: Dat limit ou se 2 janvye, pa 15 janvye.

strings.text: Junior Kindergarten and Kindergarten apply two weeks ahead of every other grade, and hear back six weeks earlier. The teacher recommendation is due Jan 15 — after the application, which is correct and not a misprint.

strings.text: Which instrument depends on the grade, and the split does not follow this band: **WPPSI-IV for Grade 1, WISC-V for rising Grades 2–4**. Either is $300, booked and paid directly with a CAIS-designated psychologist — appointments open the day after Labor Day, and you book with one psychologist only.

Ni youn ni lòt koute $300, ou rezève l epi peye l dirèkteman ak yon sikològ CAIS deziyen — randevou yo louvri nan jou ki apre Labor Day la, epi ou rezève ak yon sèl sikològ.

strings.text: Grades 1–4 sit inside the **same CAIS screening population** as JK/K — the consortium brochure covers Pre-K through Grade 4 — but on the **later Grades 1–12 calendar**. So the assessment is the JK/K one while every date is the older bands'. The instrument itself splits at **Grade 1 vs Grade 2**, not at the band boundary: a Grade 1 applicant takes the WPPSI-IV, a rising Grade 2–4 applicant the WISC-V.
strings.t: Nivo 1–4 yo antre nan **menm gwoup evalyasyon CAIS la** ak JK/K — bwochi konsòsyòm nan kouvri depi Pre-K rive 4yèm ane — men yo swiv **kalandriye ki pi ta a pou nivo 1–12**. Konsa, evalyasyon an se sa JK/K a pandan tout dat yo se sa nivo pi wo yo. Enstriman an li menm separe ant **1ye ane ak 2yèm ane**, pa nan limit nivo antre a: yon kandida pou 1ye ane pase WPPSI-IV la, yon timoun k ap monte nan 2yèm–4yèm ane pase WISC-V la.
Prevwa frè tès la apa

strings.text: The **$300** CAIS fee is paid **to the psychologist, not to the school**, and is on top of the school's own **$100** application fee. Payment is due within 24 hours of confirming the appointment, is non-refundable for appointments made after Jan 1, 2027, and a **$100 cancellation fee** applies once paid — with no refund at all inside 72 hours of the appointment.
strings.t: Frè CAIS **$300** la, ou peye l **bay sikològ la, pa bay lekòl la**, epi li anplis frè aplikasyon **$100** lekòl la mande. Peman an dwe fèt nan 24 èdtan apre w konfime randevou a, yo pa remèt li pou randevou ou pran apre 1ye janvye 2027, epi yon **frè anilasyon $100** aplike depi w fin peye — san okenn ranbousman ditou nan 72 èdtan anvan randevou a.

strings.text: Grades 5–8 are at **Bissell**; grades 9–12 at **Cannon**. The published calendar names a grades 9–12 open house on **Nov 5, 2026, 1:30 p.m. at Cannon** — no grades 5–8 event is listed, so arrange that visit through the portal.

strings.text: The break from the younger bands: no psychologist, no CAIS. The school hosts its own testing day — **Feb 6, 2027** — and you may instead sit any other ISEE date booked through the ISEE website. It "measures verbal and quantitative ability, mathematics skills, reading comprehension, and writing skills"; book early enough that scores arrive before the Feb 26 deadline.
strings.t: Sa k diferan ak nivo pi piti yo: pa gen sikològ, pa gen CAIS. Lekòl la òganize pwòp jounen tès pa l — **6 fevriye 2027** — epi olye sa ou ka pase ISEE a nenpòt lòt dat ou rezève sou sit entènèt ISEE a. Li "mezire kapasite vèbal ak kantitatif, konpetans nan matematik, konpreyansyon lekti, ak konpetans nan ekri"; rezève ase bonè pou nòt yo rive anvan dat limit 26 fevriye a.

strings.t: Ki kanpis w ap aplike pou li

strings.text: This band spans two addresses. **Grades 5–8 apply for and attend Bissell**; **grades 9–12 apply for and attend Cannon**. The admissions office itself is on Cannon, in the Levine Center, whichever campus your child is headed for. Note too that the only named open house here is the **grades 9–12** one — a middle-school visit is arranged individually rather than at a published event.
strings.t: Nivo sa a kouvri de adrès. **Nivo 5–8 aplike pou Bissell epi yo ale la**; **nivo 9–12 aplike pou Cannon epi yo ale la**. Biwo admisyon an li menm nan Cannon, nan Levine Center la, kèlkeswa kanpis kote pitit ou prale a. Note tou ke sèl jounen pòt ouvri ki nonmen isit la se sa **nivo 9–12** la — yon vizit nan mwayèn nan òganize endividyèlman olye nan yon aktivite ki pibliye.

strings.text: The TOEFL is an **addition to this band's process, not a replacement for it**: "international applicants are asked to take the TOEFL test to measure the ability to use and understand the English language," on top of the ISEE and the same deadlines. The Duolingo English Test is not mentioned. Visa, I-20 and SEVIS procedures — and whether the application fee differs — are **not published**; ask admissions directly before you start.
strings.t: TOEFL la se yon **bagay anplis nan pwosesis nivo sa a, li pa ranplase l**: "yo mande kandida entènasyonal yo pase tès TOEFL la pou mezire kapasite pou itilize ak konprann lang angle a," anplis ISEE a epi ak menm dat limit yo. Yo pa mansyone Duolingo English Test la. Pwosedi viza, I-20 ak SEVIS — ak si frè aplikasyon an diferan — **yo pa pibliye yo**; mande admisyon an dirèkteman anvan w kòmanse.
Rezève ISEE a bonè.

strings.text: The school hosts one testing day (Feb 6, 2027) and otherwise you book your own date through the ISEE website — either way scores must reach the school by Feb 26. International applicants add the TOEFL to this list rather than substituting it.
strings.t: Lekòl la òganize yon jounen tès (6 fevriye 2027) epi apa de sa ou rezève pwòp dat pa w sou sit entènèt ISEE a — nan toude ka yo, nòt yo dwe rive nan lekòl la anvan 26 fevriye. Kandida entènasyonal yo ajoute TOEFL la sou lis sa a olye yo ranplase l.
